findings.claim: cli-login.md now documents that login writes the Vault token to ~/.vault-token, but its sources omit cli/src/localstack_cli/auth/vault_token_file.py, the code that does it, so kmctl review due will not flag the page when that file changes.

The secrets.tf row in vault-human-auth.md reads as the file's full list of human-auth KV writes (operator, OpenViking consumers, smoke client), but secrets.tf also writes the OIDC client secrets for oauth2-proxy, its registry-ui copy, grafana and ov-dash. Either name those or say the row lists only the human credentials.

Several prose lines added in this change run past 80 characters, against check 1 of slop-scan-for-docs.md. Examples are the repo-root path rewrites in gcs-backups.md (lines 26, 53-58, 62, 86), monitoring.md:66, edge-routes.md:43, registry-ui.md:102 and the Server bullet in nats.md:16. Rewrap them.

verdict.text: The change does what the plan asks.

All 19 reference pages carry the three front matter keys, every build-history line spike:docs-reconcile/1 listed for docs/reference is rewritten as a current fact, and the claims I checked against the code hold, including the new ones (operators assignment, TOTP MFA, Alloy OTLP relay, OpenViking firewall callers, the gemini summary model, the reflection pass, the unhooked oauth2-proxy guard).
Three non-blocking fixes remain: one missing source, one row that reads as more complete than it is, and long lines.
`loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree: "stamp green: bb603ee847b48a3b00957b929b29bee14ba7101884119a9248d8238a022bf706", with gate cli_tests and eval rows r1 to r4 all `pass`.
Rows r1 to r4: read each command.
r1 parses the front matter and fails on a missing key, empty sources or an extra key.
r2 fails on any notice.
r3 fails on a nonzero exit or a warning naming docs/reference/.
r4 fails on a backticked token that is a suffix of a tracked path.
Each asserts its fails_when.
r5, judgment.

Read the diff of all 19 pages and checked claims against code on cli-login, cluster-roles, dash, vault-human-auth, openviking, monitoring, registry-ui, bootstrap-secrets, cli-breakglass, edge-routes, nats, python-observability, vault-login-mfa, gcs-backups and tls-certificates: oidc.tf: clients are smoke, nomad, memex, oauth2-proxy, grafana, ov-dash and hermes-dashboard.
`operators` names developer and admin and is used by oauth2-proxy, grafana and hermes-dashboard.
No client uses allow_all, and oauth2-proxy carries both the dash and registry-ui redirect URIs.
identity.tf: TOTP method and userpass enforcement, OpenViking consumers, the openviking-user group, the jwt-lab mount.
secrets.tf writes default/vault/<username> for each consumer.
login.py and auth/vault.py: the `TOTP passcode for <addr>:` prompt, "Using the first" when there are several methods, the three-cause error, save before revoke, the ~/.vault-token write.
.devcontainer/devcontainer.json passes --env-file.
alloy.hcl: OTLP on 127.0.0.1:4319 and 4320, exporting to 192.168.2.47:4317.
embark's otlp_endpoint is 127.0.0.1:4319.
infrastructure/services.tf admits .47 and .30 on 9090.
configure_network.yml still opens 4646, 8200 and 8500 to 192.168.0.0/16.
openviking.hcl and ov.conf.json: `-m ov_ext`, gemini/gemini-3.5-flash-lite, OV_REFLECT_MODEL ollama/deepseek-v4.1-flash, interval 3600, lab/jasper, liveness grace 60m.
The virtual key carries embark, gemini and ollama.
Port 1933 admits .50, .30, .47 and .29.
registry-ui: .pre-commit-config.yaml has no hook for check_oauth2_proxy_guard.py or for the registry-ui backend.
The guard runs with no arguments and exits 0.
bootstrap playbooks: init.json stat with an env fallback, and the podman auth files skipped when the user is empty.
haproxy.hcl serves /metrics on The breakglass runbook opens with a connectivity check, and the command always exits 0.
nats.hcl has the exporter on 7777, which only .47 may reach.
prometheus.hcl reads the `metrics_path` meta and has no `metrics_port`.
dash tiles.json: six groups, with openviking and ov-dash as two tiles and registry covering registry-ui.
CLI claims: ran `uv run --directory cli localstack <cmd> --help` for login, breakglass, deps, vault grants, env, token, whoami, config, logout, status, service, secret and monitor.
--insecure, --no-probe and --with-shims exist.
The justfile has mfa_status, mfa_enroll and mfa_reset.
Sources: every entry I sampled is code the page describes.
f1 is the one gap I found.
Slop: no em dashes and no ` -- ` left in docs/reference.
Ticket codes are gone (the one regex hit is a numbered list).
Semicolon splices became two sentences.
The long lines are f3.
f1: cli-login.md describes the ~/.vault-token write, and the file that does it, auth/vault_token_file.py, is not in sources.
Add it.
f2: the secrets.tf row in vault-human-auth.md leaves out the OIDC client secret writes in the same file.
Name them, or scope the row to human credentials.
f3: long lines from the repo-root path rewrites.
Rewrap them to 80.
A few "now" and "no longer" phrasings remain outside the spike's list (openviking.md:41-45 "now also runs", edge-routes.md:40 "no longer gates it").
They describe how the service differs from stock or from HAProxy, not ticket history, so I left them out of the findings.
The oauth2-proxy guard and the registry-ui backend suite have no pre-commit hook.
The page now says so correctly, and the missing hook may be worth a ticket under plan step 7.
